tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bsgrub rnga'i nang gzungs bri tshul bzhugs so// na mo shrī wan saṅgu ru badz+ra ā tsar+ya sa pa ri wā ra bh+yaḥ rdo rje 'chang dang mkha' 'gro rdo rje gur/ /bram ze mchog sred bde ba'i rdo rje dang / /shar+dha ka ra warma rin chen bzang / /yon tan tshul khrims la sogs gshegs su gsol/ /blo gros grags dang rje btsun kun snying rje/ /bsod nams rtse mo grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / /sa skya paṇa chen 'phags pa rin po che/ /dam pa kun grags la sogs gshegs su gsol/ /bdag nyid chen po bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa/ /bla chen kun rgyal nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dang / /rgya gar shes bzang 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ /bla ma mchog dang yi dam lha tshogs kyis/ /rjes bzung gdams pa rgya mtshos rab brgyan zhing / ting 'dzin nus pa chos bsrung bran 'khol ba'i/ /de 'dra'i bla ma gang bzhugs gnas nas gshegs/ /bka' drin can gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog /thugs rje can gyi brgyud pa'i bla ma dang / /byin rlabs can gyi 'dren pa'i bla ma sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma 'khor bcas thams cad kyang / /gnas 'dir gshegs shing 'di la bzhugs nas ni/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /dam chos bsgrub pa'i bar chad zhi ba dang / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus stsol/ /dngos grub 'byung ba'i yi dam lha yi tshogs/ /dges pa rdo rje 'khor lo bde mchog dang / /rdo rje phur pa gshin rje'i gshed dmar sogs/ /rgyud sde bzhi yi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams/ /gnas 'dir gshegs shing rnga chen 'di nyid la/ /brtan par bzhugs nas sngags 'chang dpon slob rnams/ /gzhan don bsgrub phyir dngos grub ma lus pa/ /char gyi rgyun bzhin 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs/ /ma hā kā la lcam dral yum chen dang / /tsa turmu kha yab yum 'khor bcas dang / /gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra lcam sring sogs/

/sa skya'i bka' bsrung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /'dir gshegs rnga chen 'di la brtan bzhugs nas/ /bstan pa'i snying po rdo rje theg pa yi/ /bstan pa mi nyams phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang / /bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe rab brtan zhing / /bstan la zhugs pa'i 'gro rnams skyid par mdzod/ /dam tshig ldan pa'i sgrub po 'khor bcas kyi/ /dam pa chos kyi bar chad byed pa yi/ /dam nyams phyi nang gsang ba'i dgra bgegs rnams/ /dam bcas bzhin du sgrol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /dgra bo'i khrag dang don snying dbang po lnga/ /dgra tshil zhun chen khrag zhag rgya mtsho dang / /dgra bo'i 'khris chen sha rus gtor chen sogs/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag cag dpon slob kyi/ /nyams chag bskangs shing 'phrin las sgrub pa dang / /pha rol rbod gtong mi mthun phyogs zhi nas/ /tshe ring dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /mdor na zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las rnams/ /gang bcol thogs pa med par bsgrub pa dang / /sa lam bgrod nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa/ /myur du 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ /dpal mgon mahā kā la'i gzi brjid dang / /lha chen nag po gdong bzhi'i mthu rtsal dang / /las mgon pho mo rnams kyi 'phrin las kyis/ /gnas mchog 'dir yang bkra shis deng 'dir rtsol/ /zhes dang / oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes pa gzhogs gcig la bri// ༈ /oṃ na mo gu ru bud+dha bo dhi sa twa sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ oṃ shrī he badz+ra ya/ shrī tsakra saṃ bha ra ya/ badz+ra kī li kī lī ya/ shrī rak+ta ya mā ṛ maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ e ka dza ṭi de ba in+d+ra si yai/ mahā kā li de byai/ badz+ra tsa turmu kha ya/ oṃ gṛ ha rā dza gṛ ha rā dza ku ma ku ma khuṃ thi ma hā pi sha tsa/

badz+ra kā la yak+ṣa ya badz+ra kā li yak+ṣi ṇi ye/ badz+ra yak+ṣa pu tra ya/ badz+ra ru dra bha ṭa ya/ badz+ra ru lu rāk+kha si/ oṃ badz+ra shān+tiṃ pad+ma kurtiṃ bh+yoḥ oṃ sarba ma ra kriṣ+ṇa ka pā la ma la dha ra sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ā sa na tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes dang / oṃ de ba pi tsu badz+ra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya shā sa no pa ha ri ṇe/ e ṣa/ a pash+tsi ma/ kā lor+dha mi daṃ/ rat+na tra ya/ a pa kā rī ṇaṃ/ ya di satwaṃ/ pra ti dz+nyā/ sma ra si/ ta da/ i daṃ duṣ+ṭān/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛh+na gṛh+na/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ dī na me ke na/ gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad mā ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ e ka dza ṭi de ba in+d+ra si hūm̐ bh+yoḥ oṃ ro ru ro ru bi tiṣ+ṭha ba do si/ kā ma la/ rak+ṣa si hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐/ oṃ hūm̐ shrī ye de wi kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐/ ma ma sha trun a mu ka mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kā la rā tri ṭa/ ḍom+bhi ni/ tsaṇ+ḍa li/ rak+kha si/ siṅgha li/ de bī hūm̐ bh+yoḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ mo'i bod pa ……oṃ ro ru ro ru tri tsa pa la/ a shuka me/ ma hūm̐/ ma bh+yoḥdzaḥdzaḥ traka ……mo'i rbad pa rak+sha kha mun tra/ ru lu ru lu traka rak+sha snying khrag snying bh+yoḥ pu tra pu tra bh+yoḥ sha sha traka sha sha traka trag mo tra pa sha truṃ mā ra ya/ mo'i bsad pa ……ma hā rak+sha tsit+ta/ srog trun trun/ ka ma la rak+sha tsit+ta srog trun trun/ gu h+ye rak+sha tsit+ta srog trun trun/ tṛ baṃ rak+sha tsit+ta srog trun trun/ ma ma tsa rbur tsit+ta srog trun trun/ pu ru tsa luṃ tsit+ta srog trun trun/ gnod byed bgegs thams cad mā ra ya/ pho'i bod pa ……oṃ a li a li ma/ dzaḥdzaḥ shaṃ shaṃ li shod ded/ a shod ded/ mu rmur spu gri a li ma dzaḥdzaḥ

nag mo sha la rubs dzaḥdzaḥ mo rbad pa ……dh+rika dh+rika ya du pa sha ni sod/ dum shig ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha/ ya nṛya nṛ/ mon bu dzaḥ mon bu khrag la 'jib dzaḥ pho'i bsad pa ……nri na rbad/ du na rbad/ shi na rbad/ shag shig rbad/ mon bu pu tra shi rbad/ yam rmugs ling 'dus kham shod pa ya mo dzaḥ dgra bo'i rus la khrol khrol/ gser gyi spu gri ya ma rbad/ gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad mā ra ya/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas/ byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ chos skyong ba'i bsrung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad/ chos rnga 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas/ rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyud byin gyi rlabs du gsol/ a dhiṣ+ṭha na a dhiṣ+ṭha te swā hā/ khyad par du yang dam tshig dang ldan pa bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib las ngan thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor legs pa'i yon tan thams cad puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ 'gro ba ma lus pa thams cad wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi dgra bgegs mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad ma ra ya phaṭa/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ ye dhar+m+mā he tu pra bhā wa he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba tad/ te ṣāñtsa yo na ro dha e wam̐ ba dī ma hā shra mā ṇaḥ ces pa 'di gzhogs gcig la bri/ rnga'i nang la bri ba'i gzungs rim pa 'di rnams sa skya pa ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis smras pa/ bsgrub rnga 'di'i phyi'i rim sogs bya tshul/ dam pa kun dga' grags kyis mdzad pa'i rnga bsgrub pa'i shog rim dang / pho nya'i las rim zhes pa na yod pas der gzigs par zhu// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ bsgrub rnga'i nang gzungs 'dri tshul/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
